offering_description.value: Provides cloud-based financial software for consumers, small businesses and accountants, covering tax preparation, accounting, payroll, payments, marketing and personal finance. Sells mainly through subscriptions, usage fees and assisted tax services, delivered through its own online platform.

primary_products.value: small business accounting software; tax preparation software; payroll and payments software; email marketing software; personal finance app

primary_services.value: assisted tax preparation; payment processing; bookkeeping services; credit monitoring and loan referral marketplace

customer_segment.value: B2C: individual taxpayers and consumers using tax and personal finance products; B2B: small and mid-market businesses, accountants and bookkeepers, and financial partners advertising on its platform

end_markets.value: small business accounting; consumer tax preparation; payments; personal finance; accounting profession

revenue_model.value: subscription: accounting, payroll and tax software subscriptions; transaction or usage fees: payment processing, payroll and per-return tax filing fees; service fees: assisted tax preparation and bookkeeping services; advertising: referral and marketing fees from financial product partners
revenue_model.category: subscription; transaction or usage fees; service fees; advertising

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: develops cloud software and AI platform, sold directly to consumers, small businesses and accountants; financial intermediary: payments processing and lending and credit marketplace connecting customers with financial partners

geography_served.value: global: Primarily US, with operations in Canada, UK, Australia and other countries

specialization.value: related lines: small business software, consumer tax, credit and marketing platforms sharing financial data and customers

distribution_channels.value: online: websites and mobile apps for direct downloads and subscriptions; direct sales: sales teams for mid-market and accountant customers; partners / resellers: accountants and retail partners selling software

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and security rules, IRS e-file requirements, payments and lending regulation from FTC, CFPB and state regulators
